entries.potential_role: A separately pre-registered pilot over the measured secondary corpus after a successor semantics protocol explicitly handles its observed publication-year scope. It may support post-snapshot discovery cases but is not an NLM baseline substitute.
blockers: The acquired payload matches all three published aggregate counts, but its measured publication-year scope does not match the reported post-1949 scope: 280 records are dated 1946-1949. All years are parseable, although 751,238 values are not plain YYYY.
The misleading meshMajor field remains resolved only on the bounded five-record public sample. Corpus-wide assignment semantics have not been audited.

The 416-record semantics protocol was frozen before payload access and deliberately rejects records outside its declared 1950-2013 strata. It remains immutable. A separately named 448-record successor is now frozen after source audit and before semantics selection; its bounded maintained-current comparison has not yet run.
The measured secondary corpus is not the complete 21,508,439-record 2013 NLM baseline, and the two totals are not a measured coverage fraction.
Only a 2013 snapshot is relevant here, so it cannot supply the missing 2007, 2011, and 2012 releases.
Using it changes the experimental population and therefore requires a new pre-registration rather than a source-status flip.
entries.next_action: Under the pinned 448-record successor protocol, generate the deterministic sample into ignored local state, replay it before any network request, and commit only the bounded maintained-current PubMed comparison manifest.
